data.text: Prevent fake profiles with instant identity checks, age verification, selfie matching, and document verification at signup and high-risk actions.
Verify high-value users, reduce chargebacks, detect fraudulent upgrades, and automate refunds and payouts for premium subscriptions and high-value transactions.
Enable compliant onboarding of creators, automated earnings payouts, identity checks, and robust fraud-resistant monetisation features for influencers.
Secure real-time interactions with continuous fraud monitoring, impersonation checks, and seamless payout automation for hosts and content creators.
Ensure trust in smaller communities with lightweight KYC, effective abuse prevention, and verified user badges for enhanced safety.
Support compliant onboarding, robust fraud prevention, and efficient payouts across diverse geographies with scalable verification workflows.
